'''Darnir Battlebeard''' was a [[dwarf]] member of the [[Human Expedition]] to [[Kalimdor]] and brother of [[Grumnir Battlebeard]]. Wielding the [[Battlebeard Axe]], he was a powerful warrior who set off for [[Kalimdor]] during the [[Third War]] and made a name for himself battling the Horde. He was killed by the [[orc]] [[Scartusk]] as the Alliance and Horde forces established a truce to head towards Hyjal, and Scartusk claimed the Battlebeard family axe for his own.<ref name="A Journey for Vengeance" />
